headline: 《Construction》Presale Market in Six Major Cities Restructures: Taipei Rises Against the Trend, Rigid Value Returns - Finance
summary: Taipei's average presale home price rose 7% and transaction volume increased 4.2% in the first half of 2026. New Taipei's average price rose 4.4%, while its volume fell 5.5%.
why: Housing prices and transaction volumes reflect property market health, which matters for developers, banks and household wealth.
